segments.text:
All beleevers through the knowledge of that Juſtification
of life given by the Father, and brought forth by the bloud of Chriſt, have this as their great priviledge of that new Covenant, peace with God, and reconciliation, whereby they that were afarre off, were brought nigh by that bloud, and have (as the Scripture ſpeaks) peace paſſing all underſtanding, yea, joy in God, through our Lord Jeſus Chriſt, by whom wee have received the Atonement.
